notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with mana to cast it.
easyPrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast an instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Noyan Dar triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on Grove of the Burnwillows and causing it to indefinitely become a 0/0 creature with haste.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 3.
